raw_segments.text: Meanwhile, he continued the business of undressing, and at last showed his chest and arms.
As I live, these covered parts of him were checkered with the same squares as his face.
His back, too, was all over the same dark squares.
He seemed to have been in a thirty years' war and just escaped from it with a sticking
Still more, his very legs were marked, as if a parcel of dark green frogs were running
up the trunks of young palms.
It was now quite plain that he must be some abominable savage or other shipped aboard
of a wailman in the South Seas, and so landed in this Christian country.
I quake to think of it.
A peddler of heads, too, perhaps the heads of his own brothers.
He might take a fancy to mine.
